name: Scores4AI - OpenRouter model sync
purpose: Schedule a POST request to the Scores4AI Netlify sync endpoint so OpenRouter model metadata stays cached in Supabase.

requiredVariables.OPENROUTER_SYNC_CRON_SECRET: copy the same value configured in Netlify

notes: This file is a Make.com recipe with exact module settings. If your Make workspace supports blueprint import, map these values into the imported HTTP and scheduler modules; otherwise create the two modules manually.
Do not put OPENROUTER_API_KEY or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Make. Make only needs the sync secret because Netlify already holds the real server-side secrets.
